tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus zab mo gter gyi mdzod las: rig 'dzin dzap kyi bkol byang bzhugs:

rtsa gsum yongs 'dus lha la 'dud: rig 'dzin dzap kyi dgongs pa ni: rtsa gsum lha ni sngags yin la: sngags kyang lha yi rnam par shar: lha sngags rnam dbyer mi phyed pa: dper na yid bzhin nor bur mtshungs: nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nas: gsol btab dgos 'dod 'byung ba bzhin: bzlas pas thugs dam rgyud bskul na: dngos grub 'byung bar the tshom med: sa ma ya: de yang bsnyen dang nye bsnyen dang: sgrub dang sgrub pa chen po bzhis: snying po sngags kyi gzer gdab cing: 'phro 'du phrin las dgongs pa bskyang: sa ma ya: de la dang po bsnyen pa ni: lha la snyan gsan 'beb pa ste: rang byung sbas pa'i gnas chen ni: grub thob gong mas byin brlabs pa: bkra shis byin chags 'tshe ba med: 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba bral ba'i sar: snang ba'i mi la rin gyis btsal: mi snang lha la gtor mas brngan: sa yi skyon sbyangs dbang du bya: srung ba mtshams kyi phur pa gdab: rang dbang 'dus par gyur pa na: rang byung rdo rje'i brag skyibs sam: sgrub pa'i khang pa mtshan ldan du: bkra shis sa blangs stegs bu ni: gru bzhi lham pa mdzes par brtsigs: bla ma yab yum byang sems dang: bdud rtsi lnga yis chag chag gdab: mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor ci rigs bzhengs: khyad par sku yi rten nyid du: sku tshab dngos sam rjes mthun nam: yang na ras 'dul byas pa'i gzhir: sel med bdud rtsi byang chub sems:

tshon sna lnga rnams bsres byas la: lha bzo dam tshig ldan pa yis: rtsa gsum kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal: mtshan rdzogs brjid ldan bris pa'i rgyab: bsnyen sgrub rnam pa bzhi yi sngags: rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa'i mthar: gu ru rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: rten 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas kyang: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag la: zhal ston byin rlobs dngos grub stsol: ces dang dbyangs gsal rten snying bri: rab gnas tshul bzhin byas pa dgram: gsung rten tsakra bca' ba ni: gro ga 'am ni dar shog la: 'khor lo mu khyud lnga ldan gyi: lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga'i dbus: dgongs rgyud gsang sngags phreng du dgod: mtha' skor thod phreng rtsa sngags dang: sgrub pa'i sngags kyi phreng ba bri: gong ras rigs gsum sems dpa'i sngags: mu khyud dang po 'dab bzhi la: bka' bab bzhi yi mtshan sngags dang: gnyis par rin chen zur brgyad la: rig 'dzin rnam brgyad mtshan gyi sngags: bar mtshams rig 'dzin spyi dril dgod: gsum par mkha' 'gro rnam gnyis dang: snyan brgyud bla ma'i sngags kyis brgyan: bzhi par rtsa gsum spyi dril dang: dbyangs gsal sgo ba bzhi yi sngags: rten 'brel snying po'i mtha' rten cing: kun la rang rang dzap dgongs dang: mthun pa'i spel tshig so so 'am: spyir btang ji ltar 'thad pa dang: lnga par nor 'dzin pa tras brgyan: dri bzang bdud rtsi lnga yis byug:

rab gnas tshul bzhin byas pa nyid: sku yi rten gyi g.yas su bshams: thugs rten srog gi phur pa ni: tsan dan las byas sor bcu gnyis: rgya mdud gong mar ring bsrel dang: bla ma'i sku gdung sku bal bcug: chang bzung bsnyen sgrub gsang sngags dang: rgya mdud 'og mar byang chub sems: dkar dmar 'dres pa'i ril bus gtams: rab gnas legs byas g.yon du bshams: mdun du yon tan gtor chen dang: rgyab du phrin las dngos grub rdzas: tshe gal la sogs ci 'byor dgod: gal te spros med rnal 'byor pas: de rnams thams cad ma 'byor yang: gu ru'i gtor chen tsam la brten: gang yang sman rag gtor mchod sogs: bag dro brjid dang ldan par bsham: bar chad bsal zhing byin chen dbab: de nas sgrub khang sgo drung du: mtshan ma'i rten dang mchod gtor bshams: mthu chen rgyal po chen po bzhir: phyi mtshams srung ba'i phrin las gsol: rdo rje'i gar gyis phyogs mtshams bcing: chos nyid stong pa'i phyag rgyas gdab: de ni bsnyen sgrub sta gon no: sa ma ya: de nas bde ba'i gdan la 'dug: lus ngag yid gsum rnal du dbab: bla mar mos gus drag tu bya: ci mdzad khyed shes blo snying gtad: dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'jig sla dang: las 'bras bslu med don la bsam: srid la nges 'byung bcos min bskyed: skyabs 'gro la sogs rgyud sbyang ba'i: sngon 'gro'i rim pa tshul bzhin bya:

khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom: gsol 'debs bsnyen pa bye ba 'am: 'bum phrag gcig gi mtha' rten bzla: dbang blang thugs yid bsres byas la: dus gsum spros bcad gnyug mar bzhag: bsam gtan snod du rung ba na: las kyi rim pa gzhung bsrangs la: bdag dang mdun rten dbyer med par: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor chen por bsgom: mchod cing bstod pas mnyes par byas: khyad par dkyil 'khor gtso bo nas: 'khor gyi bar rnams thams cad la: re re bzhin du sems bzung zhing: rang sems lha skur shar ba na: gsal dwangs rnyogs pa med pa'i ngang: yun thung grangs mang rtse gcig bsgom: goms nas sgom yun je ring bya: de ltar brtson pas yid kyi yul: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs gsal snang 'char: bar du rlung sems zin pa la: stong gzugs lha sku dbang po gsal: tha ma rlung sems lha yi sku: rnam smin rig 'dzin grub pa'i rtags: lus nyid lha skur rang shar 'byung: lha dang sems byung chos nyid gsum: dbyer med dgongs pa'i gdeng thob nas: bskyed rim mtha' ru phyin par 'gyur: gzhan yang nga rgyal brtan pa dang: dag pa dran pa spel mar bslab: de lta bu yi bskyed pa'i rim: ting 'dzin srog tu bzung nas kyang: bsnyen pa'i dzap dgongs dngos gzhi ni: thog mar dgongs brgyud rgyal ba rnams: dzap kyi phrin las chen por bskul: hūm̐ hrī: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i dkyil 'khor lha:

snang stong gzugs sku mtshan dpe lams se lam: grags stong sngags kyi dzap sgra 'u ru ru: rig stong zang thal ye shes sha ra ra: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dgongs pa gsal brtan cing: bzlas brjod rdo rje'i tshig gis rgyud bskul te: ma 'grub bar du rtse gcig sgrub lags na: rig 'dzin mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ces bskul bzlas pa'i dmigs pa bcas: bla ma zhi khro'i yang gsang bzla: stong stong tshigs sam thun gyi mthar: dzap kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: lha dang dbyer med sngags kyi mchod pa'i sprin: sman gtor rak+ta'i longs spyod dang bcas 'bul: ting 'dzin dzap kyi dam tshig nyams chag bskang: dbang skur byin rlobs mchog thun dngos grub stsol: ma hā sa ma ya man+t+ra pū dza ho: sarba pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes bskul gsol ba rtse gcig gdab: thugs yid bsres la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: gnyis pa nye bar bsnyen pa ni: lha nyid dbang du byed pa ste: de yang brda' brgyud rig pa 'dzin: spyi dang khyad par sgo nas 'jug: thog mar nus pa'i rtsal 'chang phyir: gsang bdag dpa' bo'i bzlas pa bya: de bzhin 'jam dpal mkhyen pa dang: thugs rje chen po'i brtse ba che: bka' bab slob dpon rnam bzhi la: bsten nas lha dang gnyis med cing: rgyud lung bka' bab rig rtsal 'byongs: sde snod rgyud sde'i yon tan rdzogs:

grol ba bzhi ldan chen por bzla: sa ma ya: gsum pa sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: lha dang dbyer med bya ba ste: dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag che: rig 'dzin yongs rdzogs sgo nas 'jug: de yang bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dpal: pad+ma thod phreng la bsten nas: bdag don byin rlabs nus rtsal smin: gsang mtshan thugs kyi sgrub pa yis: dngos grub kun la rang dbang bsgyur: man+dā ra ba la bsten nas: 'chi med ye shes gong du spel: mtsho rgyal la bsten bde chen bskyed: mchog gi rig 'dzin rnam brgyad kyis: rdo rje'i 'dzab dang ting 'dzin gyis: 'bru brgyad 'od gsal dgongs pa bskyangs: rnam bzhi'i ye shes 'khor lo bskor: rta skad thengs gsum dbyings su bskyal: thal 'byin bzhi yis 'khor 'das bsre: rtsa rlung byang sems dbu mar bstim: snang srid bdud rtsi'i bcud du bskyil: rtog tshogs dregs pa zil gyis mnan: gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs tshar thag bcad: de lta bu yi dgongs pa yis: dpal chen dgu dang dbyer med 'gyur: sa ma ya: bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ni: dbang sgyur mchog gi ting 'dzin te: snyan brgyud bla ma la bsten nas: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dkyil 'khor bsgrub: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi: byin rlabs dngos grub phrin las brtan: sgo srung dpa' bo yab yum la: bsten nas zhi rgyas dbang drag bsgrub: gang yang kun gyi thogs ma ru:

dzap kyi thugs dam chen po bskul: bar du dmigs pa rtse gcig pas: bzlas brjod chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bya: mthar ni dzap kyi mchod sprin 'bul: gsol ba gdab cing gdung shugs bskyed: dbang dang dngos grub blangs byas la: lha dang dbyer med nga rgyal bskyed: gzhi dus phung khams skye mched kun: ma 'gags lam gyis lha skur shar: 'bras bu rang bzhin chos kyi sku: gzugs su bzhengs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang: mi phyed dag pa dran pa yis: bskyed rim mchog gi nyer rgyud bsgyur: mdor na gsal ba rnam gsum la: brten nas sku yi ting 'dzin bsgrub: snying po sngags kyi gzer gdab pas: gsung gi nus pa rgyud la zhugs: 'phro 'dus dgongs pa sna tshogs kyis: yon tan phrin las 'dod rgur 'char: mthar thug lha ni sems kyi gshis: sems nyid rol rtsal lha skur snang: lha dang sems nyid dbyer med pa: dgongs pa mi 'gyur gding bskyed la: dus gsum rtog pas ma bslad pa'i: thugs dgongs ma bcos ngang du bzhag: rtsa gsum ye shes tshe 'dir 'grub: sa ma ya: rjes su dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun blangs: tshogs mchod bya zhing bskul la sogs: phrin las gzhung gi rim pa ltar: rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs par bya: khyad par thun mtshams rnal 'byor ni: gzugs snang rtsa gsum sku ru blta: snang stong chu zla lta bur bsgom: sgra grags rtsa gsum sngags su blta: grags stong brag cha lta bur bsgom:

dran rtog rtsa gsum thugs su blta: rig stong 'od gsal dgongs pa bskyang: gnas khang pad+ma drwa ba'i zhing: 'dod yon chos nyid rol pa'i rgyan: 'gro 'dug bsgul bskyod thams cad kyang: rdo rje'i gar gyis bde chen spel: bza' btung nang gi tshogs mchod dang: rjes chags gsang ba'i tshogs su spyod: nyal dus bsdu rim 'od gsal lam: zung 'jug lha sku'i ngang du nyal: ldang tshe dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mas: bde chen glu yis bskul bar bsam: lhar snang 'od gsal sgyu ma'i ngang: rnal 'byor chu bo'i rgyun la 'jug: sa ma ya: bzlas pa'i dam tshig bstan pa ni: zas gos sman la sogs pa rnams: mtha' gnyis ma lhung tshags su 'dzud: cis kyang brel ba med par bya: phyi nang rgyu 'grul rbad kyis bcad: phan tshun sus kyang mi mthong gces: mi rtag nges 'byung lcag gis bskul: gang yang dgos med blo sna bstung: bsam pa bzang po'i byang sems bskyed: bla ma'i mos gus srog tu bzung: nad zhi gdon sel dbang sdud sogs: thun mong tsam la blo mi 'phreng: mchog gi dngos sgrub thob 'dod pas: sgrub pa'i dam bca' phyi phyir bsring: khyad par 'dod thag nye ba spang: dka' thub brtul zhugs mtha' ru dbyung: de rnams nyams len spyi la gces: khyad par sngags kyi bzlas pa'i tshe: gnyid nyal glo lu 'og rlung sogs: gnas ngan len gyi spyod pa spang: tha mal tshig gis bar ma bcad: sgra med ma yin chung ba min:

mgyogs pa ma yin bul ba min: yengs min glal sogs bar chad min: sngags kyi grwa zur ma nyams bzlas: skabs der sngags kyi gzugs la dmigs: 'od zer spro bsdu gtso bor bya: res 'ga' sngags kyi sgra la dmigs: sgra mtha' chos nyid ngang du bskyal: res 'ga' sngags kyi 'bru don bsam: dad dang nges shes drag tu bskyed: mthar thug sngags kyi de kho na: skye med rdo rje'i bzlas par bzhag: mdor na ma yengs rtse gcig bzlas: yengs na ngal ba don med 'gyur: gzhan yang phra mo'i dam tshig ni: skra sen mi breg gdong mi bkru: stan gyi drod ma yal bar bya: lce dang mtsher pa sgog tsong sogs: sngags nus 'phrog pa'i bza' btung spang: me dang nyi ma'i 'od mi 'dug: dbang dang byin rlabs srung zlog sogs: gzhan don ltar snang spros pa bcad: rab ni chu bo'i rgyun bzhin te: 'bring ni nyin mtshan thun drug gam: thun bzhi'i nges pa brtan por bzung: de yang tho rangs nas bzung ste: nyi shar bar du thor thun gces: rlung rig dwangs dus lha yi skur: sems bzung bskyed rim gsal snang 'don: nyi shar nas bzung nyin phyed bar: snga dro'i thun te spro ba'i dus: 'od zer 'phro 'du'i rtsal chen sbyang: phyi yol nas bzung nyi rgas bar: phyi dro'i thun te 'dun pa'i dus: byin bsdu gsang sngags drag tu bzlas: srod 'khor nas bzung nam phyed bar: srod kyi thun te rtsub pa'i dus:

mi rtog dgongs pa'i gding chen bskyed: nyin gung mtshan gung 'thibs pa'i dus: bsam gtan 'jig pas ngal yang gso: nam yang 'du 'dzi phyi thag bsring: mi ngo mi srung dam tshig srung: lhag par dam tshig nyams pa dang: gdong mi 'phrad cing zas gos sogs: yo byad phra mo'ang blang mi bya: nyams pa mi skong grib la 'dzem: bzlas pa yun ni phreng ba ste: zhi bar shel dang tsan+dan dkar: rgyas par gser dang byang chub shing: dbang la byi ru tsan+dan dmar: drag po rak+sha seng ldeng sogs: tsher can shing dang gri yi lcags: mchog la rin chen thod phreng shis: kun la bo dhi tsi nyid bsngags: bzlas brjod grangs med 'gyur bar gsungs: gang yang srid can mes tshig dang: grangs mi tshang dang tshad las thal: nyams pa'i lag nas byung ba spang: gsang ba dri bzang chu yis bkru: mdud 'dzin la sogs tshad ldan spel: phreng ba thal mo bar du bzung: stong pa'i ngang las lag pa gnyis: rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gsal: snyoms par zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas: bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer 'phros: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi: sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs kun: phyag rgya sngags dang phyag mtshan gyi: rnam par spyan drangs zhal du zhugs: thugs kar rjes chags me yis zhu: dwangs ma sbyor mtshams nas byung ste: sngags kyi phreng bar khyab par thim: 'od zer gzi rjid dpal du 'bar: ngo bo rtsa gsum byin rlabs dbyig:

rnam par sngags kyi phreng ba'i tshul: byed las mchog dang thun mong gi: dngos grub stsol ba'i nor bur bsam: oṃ badz+ra satwa ā: sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā su kha bo dhi tsit+ta rat+na mā la a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhā te swā hā: stong phrag bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs: rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyang bstim: rten 'brel snying pos brtan par bya: 'di lta rab tu gnas pa yis: sngags kyi nor bu mchog tu 'gyur: las dang ye shes dngos grub kun: dka' ba med par 'grub par nges: skabs su rab tu 'phel ba'i sngags: oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇa pra bar+dhā na swā hā: btab pas bzlas brjod 'bum du 'gyur: de lta bu yi bsnyen phreng de: mi la mi ston lag mi 'grim: khyad par nyams pa'i phyogs kun spang: gces spras chen pos mgul du 'chang: rnal 'byor 'dod don ster bar byed: sa ma ya: bzlas pa'i gegs sel bstan pa ni: bying na gzengs bstod hur bag bya: rgod na bag phab rnam rtog gdul: bying rgod med par gnas pa'i tshe: kha zas spyod lam la sogs kyang: mtha' gnyis spangs la mnyam par spyod: dam grib mi gtsang sogs kyi mthus: sgrub pa'i ltas rnams log pa na: nyams skong bshags pa ci nus bya: khyad par rgyun gyi man ngag ni: rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng: rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems: dkar gsal rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: shes rab snyems ma yum dang sbyor:

dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: rdo rje'i skyil krung gdan la rol: thugs kar pad+ma nyi ma'i steng: nyams grib gnyen po stobs kyi lha: ye shes sems dpa' sme ba brtsegs: ljang nag phyag gnyis thal sbyar bar: bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin: khro tshul 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs me dpung rol: bum pa'i dbus su zla ba'i steng: hūm̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: bzlas pas rgyud bskul 'od zer 'phros: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang: rigs drug 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis sbyangs: tshur 'dus rgyal ba sras bcas kyi: byin rlabs nus stobs thams cad kun: bdud rtsi'i rnam pas bum nang 'khyil: de las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun lud: khro rgyal sku yi dbyibs brgyud de: rdor sems yab yum sbyor mtshams nas: char ltar babs te rang la thim: nad gdon sdig ltung thams cad dang: nyams grib mi gtsang bag chags kun: dag cing dri ma med par gyur: gsang sngags rgyal po 'di nyid bzlas: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru badz+ra satwa ma hā bā la u tsuṣ+ma kro dhi ra' dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: skabs su sngags sham 'di yang gdags: e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ sarba pā paṃ kle sham la shud+dhe shud+dhe a a swā hā: yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyang bzla: spro na smre sngags gdung bas bshags: mthar ni bla ma rdo rje sems: dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhu:

rang lus dag pa'i shel ltar bsam: ma bcos spros med ngang du bzhag: sngags nus gnod pa'i bza' btung sogs: kun spyod phra mor 'gal ba rnams: gzungs 'di yid la dran pas byang: bsgom bzlas tho rangs ma chag na: rtsa ba'i ltung ba kun kyang 'byang: gal te nyams grib tshab che na: rten 'brel las kyis sbyang ba ni: bum pa tshad ldan chas su bcug: shel dang gi waṃ sin+dhu ra: rgya spos spang spos ga pur dang: shu dag lnga tshan lnga yi rdzas: khyad par byang sems dkar dmar sogs: bdud rtsi chen po'i chu yis gtams: lha bskyed sngags bzlas 'od du zhu: 'thor 'thung bkrus pas nyams chag 'byang: yang na zhi ba'i thab khung dbus: lha bskyed til gyi sbyin sreg 'bul: mchog tu gsang ba'i khrus chu
tho rangs dus kyi dri chu bar pa/mchan

la: sngags btab phud kyis bla ma mchod: lhag ma btung zhing snying gar byugs: gsang ba'i grib sel bla med do: rgyal 'gong dam sris 'tshe ba na: rang nyid khyab bdag thod phreng rtsal: skad cig gnas 'gyur khro bo'i nyams: phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas phur pa bgegs la gzir: rtse la sprul pa'i lcags sdig dang: me mtshon tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: bar chad 'byung po thams cad dang: khyad par sgrub la the tshom pa'i: rgyal bsen dam 'gong 'byung po'i tshogs: srog nas drangs shing snying nas gzir: bka' sdod bran dang 'bangs su byas: dam la mi gnas gdug can kun: gnam lcags sdig pa'i pho nya 'phros: ye shes me yis gzhob tu bsregs: rjes shul lhag ma med par bsam: chos nyid lta ba'i gding bskyed la: gsang ba'i sngags 'di drag tu bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru artsig nirtsig pad+ma kī li kī la ya ru ru bha sha sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: skabs su hūm̐ gi snang glu len: gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod 'gyur: byad phur rbod gtong rtags byung na: rang nyid thod phreng drag po yi: thugs nas las kyi pho nya mo: seng gdong khros ma dpag med spros: sgrub la bar du gcod pa yi: byad kha phur kha rbod gtong dang: rmi lam rtags mtshan ngan pa kun: gri gug 'bar bas bkug cing gtub: bhan+dar bcug nas zhal du gsol: ye shes mes bsregs rlung gis gtor:

chos nyid ngang du thim par bsam: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭa: bcu bzhi'i sngags 'di drag tu bzla: mthar ni nyi zla'i thal mo'i bar: dgra bgegs brlag cing phyir bzlog mos: na mo: dkon mchog rtsa gsum chos srung dang: seng gdong khros ma'i bden stobs kyis: gsang sngags sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: mi dang mi min 'byung po dang: byad phur rbod gtong ltas ngan kun: sdang byed dgra yi steng du zlog: gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du bh+yo: thams cad ka dag dbyings stims la: sngags mthar phyir bzlog 'di yang gdags: ma hā sha ri raṃ bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: thal mo brdab cing dmigs pas gzir: mthar ni khro mo tshur 'dus nas: srung ba'i gur dang dbyer med bsam: oṃ badz+ra siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ ha he phaṭa ma ma kā wā tsi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: byad phur rbod gtong zhi bar 'gyur: bye brag phyir zlog bcu bzhi'i sngags: gu gul la btab gnas la bdug: yungs dkar la btab rdzas la gtor: khros chu la btab khong du btung: gnas rdzas rnal 'byor bar chad zhi: gzhan yang bying rgod gnyid rmugs dang: nyon mongs shugs drag gnyen po chung: gnas khang sgrub rdzas nyams bag dman: rnal 'byor nad gdon 'tshe ba mang: 'khor g.yog 'thab rtsod khong khro ldang: de sogs sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun: gsang ba'i nyul le'i rtags yin pas: dpal gyi pho nya chen mo dgu: gnas nas spyan drangs
sgrub khog ltar/

gtor ma 'bul: thugs dam bskul bas tshar thag bcad: spros pa'i cho ga ma grub na: rig 'dzin thod phreng drag po yi: phyag gi phur pa gsor ba las: dpal gyi pho nya skar ltar 'phros: drag shul khros 'khrugs rngams pa yis: sgrub la bar chad thams cad dang: khyad par dam sri nyul le'i dpung: snying rje khros pa'i lcags kyus bzung: ting nge 'dzin gyi brub khung bcug: mngon spyod rig rtsal phur pa dang: nad mtshon dug gi thun char phabs: ming gi lhag ma med par bcom: 'od gsal dbyings su thim par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ gha gha gha ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐: kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nān kā ya wā ka tsit+ta kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: gru gru gru: a pa tse: ru pa tse: thun du thun du: nā sha ya stam+bha ya: bi nā ya bi nā ya ka ka: phye ma phye ma: rdul phran rdul phran: hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: dgongs pa'i gdeng bskyed lta stangs gzir: phur pa 'dril zhing thun gyis brabs: gu gul la sogs dud pas bdug: mi rtog gnyug ma'i ngang du bzhag: des ni bar chad thams cad bzlog: nyams bzang 'bar na byin yang dbab: mdor na ji ltar khas blangs pa'i: sdom dang dam tshig dag par bya: re dog blo sna rbad kyis bcad: bla ma lha dang gsang sngags la:

yid ches dad pa brtan por bzung: brtson 'grus yal bar mi 'dor zhing: bzang ngan mtshan ma ci byung yang: thams cad sgyu mar yin shes na: bgegs rnams rang sar grol bar nges: sa ma ya: sgrub dang bzlas pa'i bogs 'byin ni: thog mar ngag sbyong byin rlabs shing: dbang bskur nus byin bskyed pa'i phyir: tho rangs mal nas ldang ma thag: rlung ro bsal zhing lus gnad bsrang: 'jam rlung cung zad bzung byas la: rang gi lte bar raṃ yig las: bde chen gtum mo'i me lce 'bar: lus gang nad gdon sdig sgrib bsregs: khyad par lce yi dbang po yi: nyes skyon sbyangs shing stong pa'i ngang: a yig dmar po yongs gyur las: rdo rje rtse gsum dmar po ni: stong gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can: g.yas g.yon thabs shes dbyangs gsal dang: dbus rwar zung 'jug snying po'i sngags: lte bar āḥyig dmar gsal mtshan: de mthar rten 'brel sngags kyis bskor: 'od 'phros rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi: gsung gi byin rlabs āḥdamar po: grangs med spyan drangs āḥl thim: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi: rdo rje'i ljags su byin brlabs bsam: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru dhe wa dhā ki ni dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a ā: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: oṃ badz+ra dzi hā dz+nyā na āt+ma ko3 haṃ: slar yang 'od zer 'phros pa yis: rtsa gsum lha tshogs rab 'byams kun: spyan drangs bdud rtsi'i ngo bor zhu: sngags kyi phreng bar thim pa yis:

byang chub mchog gi ye shes smin: rdo rje'i gsung du dbang bskur bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī badz+ra wa ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ: lha sngags bde chen rol pa yi: 'od kyis rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi: gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags sogs: dbyangs gsal yi ge 'od 'bar ba'i: rnam pa ā li kā lir thim: sngags kyi ye shes kun 'dus shing: nus pa 'bum du bskyed par bsam: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba man+t+ra a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhā te dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: zhes dang dbyangs gsal dag par bzla: rten 'brel snying po'i sngags bzlas pas: de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis: lce yi sngags phreng kun la khyab: byin nus 'bral med brtan par bsam: 'di lta bu yi man ngag gis: ngag gi nyes pa'i skyon kun byang: sngags kyi byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug: sngags gcig bzlas pas thams cad 'grub: nus pa 'phel zhing brtan par 'gyur: gzhan yang sngags a.a.aṭaṭa 'di legs par bris: bdud rtsi byugs shing rtsa gsum gyi: gsung gi ngo bor rab tu gnas: khong du mid la sngags gcig bzlas: 'bum du 'phel ba'i man ngag yin: de nas khrus kyi bya ba ni: legs par bsgrubs pa'i bum chu 'am: bdud rtsi dang sbyar chu gtsang mar: chos nyid rnam dag sngags kyis btab: ngo bo rdo rje ma mā ki: rnam pa ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun:

byed las sgo gsum dri ma sbyang: ye shes bskyed pa'i nus ldan bsam: baṃ badz+ra ma mā ki a mṛta kun+ḍa li baṃ: rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyang bzla: bkru zhing 'thor 'thung byas pa yis: sgo gsum sdig sgrib dag par bsam: ye shes rgyud la 'phel ba'i phyir: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i ril bu 'am: phye ma mtheb srin sbyor bas myong: oṃ: lus rtsa khams kyi rang bzhin la: dam tshig bdud rtsi gdod nas grub: ye shes bdud rtsi dbyer med thim: byin rlabs nus stobs dpal du 'bar: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī badz+ra a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: bdud rtsis lus gang bde bas myos: sgrib dag byin nus rtogs pa 'bar: dwangs ma snying dbus thig ler thim: he ru ka dang dbyer med bsam: 'dis ni dam tshig nyams chag skong: lha sngags ting 'dzin nus pa 'phel: nad rims bgegs kyis mi tshugs shing: rtsa gsum lha yis byin brlabs 'gyur: thun mtshams tshogs kyi mchod pa dang: khyad par rgyun gyi me mchod kyis: sngags kyi lhag chad nyes pa sbyang: nus pa'i rtsal kha rgyas pa'i phyir: zhi ba'i thab bam ci rigs me: til dang zas mchog la sogs bshams: oṃ āḥhūm̐: me nyid gdod nas gos dkar mo: rnam pa ye shes 'bar ba'i dbus: rtsa gsum lha tshogs thams cad kun: til gyi gong bu kha phye ltar: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa: bde chen gzi byin 'bar bar bzhugs:

bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dang: khyad par sngags kyi lhag chad sogs: rdo rje'i dam las 'gal ba rnams: sna sgo'i rlung dang lhan cig par: rdzas la thim zhing bdud rtsir bsgyur: lha rnams zhal du phul ba yis: ye shes mchog gi dgyes pa bskyed: nyes ltung thams cad bsreg par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: zhes pas til 'bru ci rigs 'bul: oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā: sgrub pa po yi nad gdon sdig sgrib sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shin+taṃ ku ru swā hā: slar yang zas mchog 'bru sman sogs: bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin phul ba yis: zag med bde bas dgyes pa'i 'od: nyi ma 'char kha'i mdangs lta bu: bdag gi rgyud la zhugs pa yis: sngags kyi ye shes rgyas par bsam: rtsa gsum sngags dang spel tshig ni: oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā: sgrub pa po'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor sngags kyi ye shes thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ: ji ltar rigs pa phul ba'i mthar: ye shes lha tshogs thams cad kun: rlung gi sbyor bas drangs pa las: lte ba'i me dang gnyis med gyur: de las 'bar ba'i me 'od kyis: rtsa khams snyigs ma thams cad bsregs: dwangs ma bde chen bdud rtsir zhu: phung khams skye mched dkyil 'khor kun: zag med bde bas dgyes par bsam: dbyings rig zung 'jug dgongs pa bskyang:

phyi nang don gyi me mchod 'di: sgrub pa'i rim pa kun la gces: skabs su bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bshams: sman raka gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: phrin las rim pa'i byin 'beb sogs: dbyangs dang rol mor bcas te bya: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs: dam tshig rdzas kyi dud pa btang: dzap dbyangs bya zhing lta gding bskyed: nyams 'bar byin brlabs ltas byung na: rgyun gyi dngos grub gsol bas blang: mdor na thabs kyi rim pa la: nam yang khyad du mi gsod cing: shes rab zab mo'i lta gding gis: bden gnyis zung 'jug chen po'i ngang: lha dang bla ma dbyer med par: mos gus dam tshig srog bzung na: rdo rje'i lam gyi bogs bskyed kun: dbyar gyi char bzhin rgyas par nges: sa ma ya: de ltar yid g.yeng kun spangs nas: bskyed pa lha yi gsal snang dang: bzlas pa sngags kyi sems 'dzin dang: 'od zer spro bsdus rtsal sbyang dang: dgongs pa mi g.yo'i gding bcas pas: rtse gcig nyams su blangs pa las: rtags dang mtshan ma cir yang 'byung: rab la rig 'dzin lha zhal mthong: gsung thos thugs kyi ye shes 'char: dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas 'od zer 'phro: bdud rtsi khol zhing rak+ta 'phyur: gtor mar bdud rtsi'i zil pa 'beb: bhan+da 'phar zhing bris sku bzhad: spos dang mar me yun du 'tsho: khyad par lus sems shin sbyong skye: rnam smin rig 'dzin thob par 'gyur: 'bring du de rnams nyams su 'char:

lha dang bla ma dbyer med par: dad dang nges shes lhag par 'gyur: rtse gcig sgrub la spro ba dang: lus bde ngag la nus pa 'byung: sems la mi rtog ye shes rnyed: zab mo'i lam 'di kho na las: mi ldog nges shes brtan po 'char: tha ma rmi lam gnas skabs su: lha sku'i gzugs brnyan mthong ba dang: bla ma mjal zhing gdams ngag gnang: seng ge glang chen rta mchog zhon: sha chen bdud rtsi ro ldan btung: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rtse dgas spyod: nyams dga' zhing dang gnas yul bgrod: de sogs mchog gi ltas su shes: nyi zla shar dang gter chen rnyed: rtsi shing lo tog me tog bzhad: chu bo yid 'ong 'phel ba sogs: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i rtags: nam mkhar 'phur dang sa 'og bgrod: dwangs pa'i shel dang nor bu rnyed: 'ja' 'od me tog char 'beb sogs: ye shes rgyas pa'i rtags su bshad: khrus byas lus las rnag khrag dang: mi gtsang srog chags 'jigs pa thon: gos dkar dri med bgos pa sogs: nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi ba'i rtags: skye bos 'dud cing 'dod yon 'bul: gos dang me tog dmar pos brgyan: rnga rol pi waṃ dbyangs snyan 'khrol: legs tshogs dbang 'dus ltas su bshad: nyam nga'i 'phrang dang g.yul las thar: go bgos mtshon thogs rdzong btsan bzung: srog chags bsad dang ri bsil sogs: srung dang drag po'i las 'grub rtags: de sogs rtags mtshan ci byung yang: lha dang bla ma gdams ngag la:

nges shes dad pa gong du spel: nga rgyal rloms sems dga' brod spang: chos nyid sgyu ma'i ngang du spyod: de lta'i rtags kyi rim pa yang: nus la ltos na dbang po rab: zla ba drug gis brtan pa thob: rnam par smin pa'i drod tshad rnyed: 'bring la bskyar te bsgrub pa yis: zla ba bcu gnyis bar du ste: tha ma spog chog dang bcas pa'i: zla ba bco brgyad rtse gcig tu: bsgrubs na nges par 'grub pa yin: mtshan ma thob min ji ltar yang: grangs kyi nges pas bsnyen pa la: dgongs brgyud bde gshegs 'bum phrag bzhi: brda' brgyud so sor de'i bzhi cha: dkyil 'khor bdag po'i 'bru 'bum ste: gsang mtshan sum char shes par bya: 'khor gyi rig 'dzin 'bum phrag bzla: snyan brgyud spyi dril 'bum bzhi 'o: phrin las dus gnad dang sbyar nas: zhag bdun thun bzhi'i rim pas bsgrub: de ltar legs par thems pa yis: bsnyen sgrub byin nus ldan pa dang: rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub la dbang: spyir ni bsnyen sgrub zab mo 'dir: 'brel ba sna re thogs pas kyang: tshe 'dir mi mthun phyogs kun zhi: tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes 'phel: zab gsang snying po'i bstan pa dar: phyi mar rnga yab sprul pa'i zhing: rig pa 'dzin pa'i gzugs gyur te: myur du byang chub 'grub par 'gyur: de phyir pad+ma'i sngags rgyud rnams: 'di nyid thugs dam snying por dril: rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par nges:

sa ma ya: de ltar bu yi bsnyen sgrub la: rtags dang dus kyi rim pa 'am: grangs kyi bzlas pa mthar phyin nas: gnas dus 'khor rdzas tshogs pa na: sgrub pa'i las rim tshul bzhin bya: dngos grub chen po rgyas par blangs: de tsam spros pas mi nus na: tshogs dang mchod pa dpung bskyed 'bul: las gzhung rgyas par bsrangs nas kyang: rdo rje srin po'i nam langs dus: dngos grub blang ba'i cho ga bya: thog mar tshe yi bzlas pa dang: rig 'dzin lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: tshe dang ye shes bcud rnams kun: dngos grub rdzas la lhag par thim: tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshul bzhin bskor: dngos grub bar chad rgyang ring bskrad: ye shes lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: nam mkha' gang ba'i rtsa gsum lha: dgyes pa chen po'i thugs ka nas: 'od 'phros bla ma yi dam dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi: sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dbyig: 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud kun: bdud rtsi 'od zer lnga ldan gyi: rnam pas bsgrub rdzas kun la thim: dngos grub kun gyi dpal du bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra ma hā gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba sid+dhipha la hūm̐ ā: kā ya wa kā tsit+ta gu ṇa karma dz+nyā na lo ka sarba sid+dhi oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: ting 'dzin gsal bas ci rigs bzla: mchod bstod 'khon gcugs nyams chag bshags: slar yang thugs dam gnad nas bskul:

hūm̐ hūm̐: ye shes 'khor lo rtsa gsum rab 'byams lha: rtag rgyun rang bzhin dgongs pa mtha' klas pa: thugs dam gnad nas bskul 'debs mi 'tshal yang: bdag cag 'dod gdung drag po'i gsol 'debs na: sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan po rjes dgongs nas: ye shes thugs rje'i gzi byin lhag par skyed: khams gsum yongs sgrol bde chen brtul zhugs kyis: mchog thun dngos grub da lta myur du stsol: spyi dril gyi sngags mthar: ma hā badz+ra sa ma ya e ā ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: zhes bskul rak+tas gzi byin bskyed: hūm̐ hūm̐: khams gsum 'khor ba chos nyid klong du bsgral: so sor rtog pa'i rak+ta dmar 'od 'khyil: bde mchog bde spyod mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dngos grub chen po'i gzi byin bskyed du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā ra ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā sid+dhi te dza sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: bdag nyid rang 'od rig ma dang: snyoms zhugs byang chub sems kyi rgyun: bdud rtsi'i bcud dang dbyer med bsam: dza gad dpa' bo'i phud kyis mchod: hūm̐ hrī: bdag nyid yab yum snang stong thabs shes sbyor: rdo rje pad+ma sbyor zhing skyod pa yis: byang chub sems sprin yum gyi mkha' la 'khyil: dza gad bde chen phud kyi mchod pa bzhes: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā ra ma hā a mṛta dza gad pū dza ho:

ma hā sid+dhi su khaṃ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: sbyor ba'i dam tshig chen po yis: thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba las: nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rtsa gsum lha: mchog tu mi 'gyur bde bas mnyes: dam tshig skong zhing ye shes bskyed: snyoms zhugs bde stong ngo bor zhu: mdun rten lha dang dbyer med thim: 'od zer rab tu 'bar bzhin pas: dngos grub mtha' dag stsol ba la: ngo mthon tshul du bzhugs par bsam: skul tshig rgyas bsdus gang rung gis: sku gsung thugs rten gnas gsum reg: yon tan gtor ma lte bar bzhag: phrin las dngos grub dam rdzas myong: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dang: thun mong mchog gi sid+dhi rnams: stan thog gcig tu thob par bsam: rten rnams bla rdor 'bral med 'chang: dzap dbyangs bya zhing nyams rtogs spar: lha dang sgrub rdzas sgrub pa po: dbyer med thig le gcig tu 'dres: ye shes chen po'i srog thob mos: ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du bzhag: lhag ma la sogs rjes kyi rim: phrin las gzhung ltar mthar dbyung ngo: sa ma ya: de ltar dngos grub blangs nas kyang: sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i: bsnyen bsgrub nyams chag zhi ba dang: nus pa 'phel zhing brtan pa'i phyir: zhi rgyas sreg blugs ci mang 'bul: gnas dang rnal 'byor bkra shis slad: re zhig sgrub pa'i khang pa ru: phrin las gzhung bsrang tshogs mchod 'bul: rgyal chen rnams la gtang rag bya:

gshegs su gsol zhing shis pa brjod: dam tshig ldan pa'i mched grogs sogs: rim gyis 'phrad la khad kyis grol: dben zhing nyams dga'i sman tshal du: ljongs rgyu bya zhing dga' ston spyad: khams kyi dub pa bsal ba dang: yul gyi bdud rtsi bstan pa yis: nyams dang rtogs pa'i bogs kyang dbyung: khyad par dus dang rnam pa kun: bsnyen bsgrub zab mo thems phyin chad: rab kyi nyin mtshan thun bzhi 'am: tha ma thun re ma chag par: phrin las rgyas bsdus gang rung ngam: rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying por dril: zab mo'i lam 'di kho na las: byang chub sgrub pa'i g.yar dam bzung: rang rgyud smin nas gzhan gyi don: dbang bskur bskyed rdzogs man ngag bstan: 'brel tshad pad+ma 'od du grol: tshom bu tshogs kyi bsgrub pa bya: tshe 'dir dngos grub rnam gnyis thob: rgyun dang dus kyi mchod par 'bad: chu bo bzhi yi rgyun 'bebs shing: ye shes klong dgu'i rtsal chen rdzogs: snying po'i bstan pa'i btsas chen 'gyur: de phyir rang smin gzhan yang smin: rang gzhan don kun 'dis 'grub 'gyur: sa ma ya: de ltar rig 'dzin yongs rdzogs kyi: dzap kyi pra khrid bkol byang 'di: rgyud dang mi 'gal lung dang mthun: man ngag kun gyi snying po'i bcud: kha tshang don 'gril lag len bde: pad+ma bdag gi thugs khrag te: ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams kyi don: sngon chad gzhan du ma bstan par:

deng 'dir lo tsā chen por gdams: nam zhig kha ba can ljongs 'dir: sgrub brgyud rtog ge'i phyi bzhin 'brang: bshad pas sgrub pa'i lad mo byed: bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi'i srog rtsa bcad: grub rtags sna re thon pa nyung: rang nyid blo sna mang ba'i dus: rig 'dzin brgyud pa ma zin par: chos dang bla mar 'khang ra byed: dngos grub than sprin bzhin du yal: de tshe da lta'i smon lam mthus: mnga' bdag yab sras lo tsā che: 'gro 'dul sgyu ma'i skyes bur shar: de dus da lta'i gdams pa ni: smon lam dbang gis lag tu son: byin rlabs stobs kyis gtan la 'bebs: thugs bskyed zab mos bod khams kun: phan bde'i phrin las rgyas par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: gu h+ya: 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pas lha mdo 'bur mo bde chen pad+ma bkod nas dngos grub tu thob pa'o// //
